text: DSH Conversation Reflow 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话排版插件，通过 shell.overlay 注册一组限定在主会话区域的样式。它约束会话内容宽度，让长文本和 Markdown 表格单元格可以换行，并使宽表格留在可用宽度内，仍需横向查看的内容保留滚动。插件不提供工具、命令或配置项，关闭 bundle 后样式随之移除。适合希望侧栏之间的对话内容更易阅读的网页端用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Conversation Reflow uses scoped styles to adjust DSH web conversation layout. It limits content width, wraps long text and Markdown table cells, and keeps wide tables within the available area with scrolling. Disabling the bundle removes its styles. No API key or external service is required.
DSH 两侧有侧栏时，怎么让中间的对话内容别挤出屏幕？
Markdown 表格太宽，能让单元格文字换行并保留必要的横向滚动吗？
Can I make long messages and table cells wrap inside the available width of the DSH web conversation?
DSH Conversation Reflow 的功能「会话内容自适应」：在主会话区域约束内容宽度并允许长文本换行，使对话适应侧栏之间的空间。
DSH Conversation Reflow 的功能「宽表格排版」：让 Markdown 表格及单元格遵循会话可用宽度并换行，仍需横向查看时保留表格容器滚动。

dsh-conversation-reflow README · Conversation Reflow：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Keep conversation text and Markdown table cells within the width available between sidebars. The plugin preserves font size and retains scrolling for content that still needs it.

The plugin uses DSH extension points and leaves with its bundle when disabled. It adds no tools, model prompts, external requests, or conversation records.
